meaning: Nonclinical recorded-pathway inspection index; not care quality, treatment appropriateness, clinical risk, provider fault or intervention benefit.
scope: Sepsis uses no lab values, demographic attributes or calendar cohorts. Workbook is a three-case technical fixture with unknown provenance.

S02.name: Long recorded first-to-last history in days

S03.name: Long first registration-to-first release interval in days

sepsis.group: distinct recorded release labels; no recorded release retained; not diagnosis or owner
sepsis.time_policy: UTC within-case intervals only; invalid endpoint occurrences make duration unavailable; no negative duration repair; complete endpoint observations required

W02.name: Long first-to-last recorded history in hours

hospital_workbook.group: all three cases; no suitable business context field
